correctness.rationale: A deterministic exact barycentric min/max reduction is proved for every pair of distinct triangle edges. Both disjoint failure regions are integrated explicitly, their complements give the universal conditional CDF, and side-choice probabilities give the full mixture and the atom. The triangle inequalities and convexity give sharp equality/limit cases. Direct independent geometry clipping and conditional simulations corroborated 20 thresholds but were not treated as proof.

value.rationale: The entire geometric penetration distribution factorizes into a shape-free conditional CDF and one natural squared-perimeter parameter. It gives sharp simultaneous stochastic inequalities for every threshold, equality rigidity of the equilateral shape, and explicit distinct triangles with identical laws; these are motivated structural geometric-probability facts rather than a single simple probability.
